stepMapping.intro: {productsCount} products found, with {slugsCount} different Wix tags. Wix does not distinguish brand and category — indicate what each tag represents. A tag classified as "Category" becomes a category under the product's brand, with a generic "General" subcategory below, to be refined later. A suggestion is pre-filled when product names confirm it; verify and correct the rest. Careful: a manufacturer name (e.g. "Purple", "Staleks") doesn't always appear at the start of every product's name — when that's the case the suggestion gets it backwards, classifying the brand as a category and vice-versa. If a tag is a brand/manufacturer name, pick "Brand" even if the suggestion says "Category".

evenements.metadataDescription: Discover our beauty workshops and events hosted by professionals.
evenements.heroSubtitle1: Throughout the year, MeriBeauty Studio & Shop comes alive with workshops, women's circles, events and shared moments. Each event is designed to create a moment away from everyday life, in a warm and inspiring atmosphere. Whether you come to learn, create or simply take a moment for yourself, you will always find a new experience to enjoy.
evenements.heroSubtitle2: Hands-on workshops, masterclasses and exclusive events hosted by passionate professionals. Book your spot now.
evenements.emptyDesc: Our workshops and events are coming soon. Come back and see us!
evenements.meetingsP1: For a long time, the seasons naturally shaped our lives. We celebrated the return of spring, the first harvests, the long summer evenings, or the moment nature fell asleep.
evenements.meetingsP2: Today, we still celebrate birthdays, Christmas and New Year, but we rarely take the time to celebrate the simple things nature offers us throughout the year.
evenements.meetingsP3: Through these gatherings, I want to reconnect with the seasons and create moments where we slow down, come together, and take time to appreciate the present. Each circle draws inspiration from a Wheel of the Year festival, but above all it is an invitation to share, create, exchange and live each season to the fullest.
evenements.meetingsP4: These gatherings are open to everyone, with no prerequisites or particular beliefs. They are offered in a spirit of conviviality and discovery and have no therapeutic purpose.
evenements.eveningsP1: What if we rediscovered the joy of the pajama parties of our childhood?
evenements.eveningsP2: The Cocoon Nights were born from this idea. One evening a month (or depending on the schedule), the salon turns into a true cocoon. Put on your most comfortable outfit and join us for an evening of treats, hot drinks, board games, creative activities and great conversations.
evenements.eveningsP3: Whether you come with a friend or on your own, the idea is simple: feel at home.
evenements.ateliersP2: Throughout the year, we invite passionate professionals to share their expertise in workshops open to everyone. Beauty, craftsmanship, wellness, skill development or creative discoveries: each workshop is led by an expert in their field.
evenements.ateliersP3: Our goal is simple: create a place where you discover, where you learn and where you leave with new knowledge... and often with beautiful encounters.
